name: Grafana
description: Gives AI clients the dashboards of a Grafana instance (title, folder, link, tags; optionally filtered by a search text) and the firing Grafana-managed alerts with the Phoedox entry each alert belongs to (matched by its instance, host or hostname label). Read-only, no import. Settings: url (e.g. https://grafana.example.org, including a sub path if Grafana is served from one) and token (a service account token with the Viewer role). The plugin reads the knowledge graph only to find matching entries.

mcpTools.name: grafana.dashboards
mcpTools.description: Dashboards with title, folder, absolute link and tags, optionally filtered by a search text.

mcpTools.name: grafana.alerts
mcpTools.description: Firing Grafana-managed alerts: alert name, severity, instance, state, active since, summary and the matching Phoedox entry.
